payload.content: A consultancy WordPress website helping government organisations and SMEs understand strategic advice, guidance, reintegration, activation and tender support before starting a conversation.
payload.description_1: Government organisations and SMEs can arrive with questions around strategy, complex processes, reintegration, activation or tender guidance. Those needs overlap, but presenting them as one general consultancy service would make it harder for a prospective client to recognise which type of guidance fits the situation.
payload.description_2: I structured Fidelyaa around strategic advice, analysis, process guidance and experience with reintegration, activation and tenders. Short explanations help organisations recognise the relevant route before contact, while the responsive hierarchy keeps the consultancy offer understandable without introducing unsupported claims about programme or business results.
